policy: Group related lifecycle gaps; one reviewed publication and hardware candidate per batch, no per-fix reboot

regression_policy.scope: Full local regression suite for completed implementation stages; no --only for batch acceptance
regression_policy.cadence: Once after final changes in a related batch; rerun only for new code, failures or specific unresolved evidence
regression_policy.manual_hardware: Do not repeat already accepted checks without a regression or a changed affected path
not_proven_by_local_suite: macOS adapters other than the validated Sequoia build

latency_acceptance.user_policy: Occasional latency spikes affecting at most 1% of samples are acceptable measurement variation
latency_acceptance.evaluation: Use a sufficiently sized sample and report count/denominator; a maximum alone does not establish frequency
latency_acceptance.threshold_note: No numeric latency threshold was specified; do not invent one as a user requirement

execution_policy.unit_of_work: A complete related contract group, not one callback or one failing check

execution_policy.acceptance: Review the entire group, run affected regressions during development, then one consolidated full regression and one candidate build after final edits
execution_policy.publication: Keep intermediate edits local; publish one reviewed batch without per-fix pushes or Actions runs
execution_policy.hardware_gate: Request explicit reboot authorization through the input form only when a meaningful integrated candidate is ready; reboot delay 10 seconds
execution_policy.closed_stages: Use make test-development; no repeated manual scan timing or reboot-success questions without new regression evidence
execution_policy.truthfulness: Report source integration, local production-path tests and offline build separately from physical inter-AP roaming; no physical handoff is available on this setup
execution_policy.version: Advance build number only after successful push and verified remote head; local edits/unpushed commits keep previous number
